_comment: Reference configuration for the AgentCore Gateway + Lambda target that exposes verifyPatient as an MCP tool. Recreate in your own account. Replace <PLACEHOLDERS>. The JWT authorizer must trust your Connect instance's OIDC issuer, and allowedAudience must equal the gateway id. See docs/pre-visit-intake-runbook.md.

inlinePayload.name: verifyPatient
inlinePayload.description: Verify a patient's identity by date of birth and ZIP code. Returns verified=true with patient_id, patient_name, and today's appointment on a match; verified=false otherwise. Call this before discussing any health information.

dateOfBirth.description: Patient date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format
